title: Home Oxygen Therapy Usage Pattern and the Medicaid Usage Share (Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility)
content:
**Questions and answers on the usage share of the Medicaid monthly rate in an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility crossover.**

**What decides the usage share?** The usage pattern on the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record — when oxygen is used.

**What share of the rate does each pattern take?**

| Usage pattern on the oxygen record | Usage share |
|---|---|
| exertion and sleep | 90 percent |
| sleep only | 75 percent |
| exertion only | 75 percent |
| continuous | the whole rate (100 percent) |

**When is the share applied?** To the monthly rate before the rate is rounded to the cent.

**Example (hypothetical rate before rounding, 200.00).** Exertion and sleep: 180.00. Sleep only: 150.00. Continuous: 200.00.
